### PA_T3_MSQ_01: In Topic 3, select all cell types residing in Loose Areolar Connective Tissue matrix: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Matrix-producing Fibroblasts
- [ ] B) Histamine-releasing Mast cells
- [ ] C) Phagocytic Histocytes / Macrophages
- [ ] D) Antibody-producing Plasma cells
- [ ] E) Mineralized Osteocytes

> **✅ Answers:** A) Matrix-producing Fibroblasts, B) Histamine-releasing Mast cells, C) Phagocytic Histocytes / Macrophages, D) Antibody-producing Plasma cells
> **Explanation:** Areolar CT matrix contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, and plasma cells.

### PA_T3_MSQ_04: In Topic 3, select all true statements regarding White Fat vs Brown Fat: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
- [ ] B) Brown fat contains dense cytochrome mitochondria for thermogenesis
- [ ] C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1)
- [ ] D) White fat serves as primary energy storage and thermal insulation
- [ ] E) White fat generates heat in hibernating newborn mammals

> **✅ Answers:** A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular, B) Brown fat contains dense cytochrome mitochondria for thermogenesis, C) Brown fat expresses Thermogenin (UCP-1), D) White fat serves as primary energy storage and thermal insulation
> **Explanation:** Brown fat is multilocular, rich in mitochondria/UCP-1 for heat generation; White fat is monolocular energy storage.

### PA_T3_MSQ_05: In Topic 3, select all components forming a Compact Bone Osteon: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Central Haversian canal containing blood vessels and nerve
- [ ] B) Concentric ossein matrix lamellae
- [ ] C) Osteocytes in lacunae spaces
- [ ] D) Canaliculi cytoplasmic channels
- [ ] E) Avascular chondrin proteoglycans

> **✅ Answers:** A) Central Haversian canal containing blood vessels and nerve, B) Concentric ossein matrix lamellae, C) Osteocytes in lacunae spaces, D) Canaliculi cytoplasmic channels
> **Explanation:** Osteons consist of Haversian canals, concentric lamellae, lacunae with osteocytes, and canaliculi.

### PA_T3_MSQ_07: In Topic 3, select all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Kupffer cells of liver
- [ ] B) Microglia of brain CNS
- [ ] C) Dust cells / alveolar macrophages of lungs
- [ ] D) Langerhans cells of skin
- [ ] E) Osteocytes of bone

### PA_T3_MSQ_08: In Topic 3, select all characteristics distinguishing Fibrocartilage from Elastic Cartilage: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Fibrocartilage contains thick Type I collagen bundles
- [ ] B) Fibrocartilage lacks perichondrium sheath
- [ ] C) Fibrocartilage resists high mechanical compression in intervertebral discs
- [ ] D) Elastic cartilage contains branching yellow elastin fibers in pinna and epiglottis
- [ ] E) Elastic cartilage has highest tensile strength among all cartilages

> **✅ Answers:** A) Fibrocartilage contains thick Type I collagen bundles, B) Fibrocartilage lacks perichondrium sheath, C) Fibrocartilage resists high mechanical compression in intervertebral discs, D) Elastic cartilage contains branching yellow elastin fibers in pinna and epiglottis
> **Explanation:** Fibrocartilage has Type I collagen, lacks perichondrium, absorbs shock in discs. Elastic cartilage has elastin in ear/epiglottis.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Topic 3, select all characteristics d" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PA_T3_MSQ_09: In Topic 3, select all plasma proteins maintaining blood physiology: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Serum Albumin (Osmotic pressure maintenance)
- [ ] B) Gamma Globulins (Humoral antibody defense)
- [ ] C) Fibrinogen (Blood clotting cascade)
- [ ] D) Prothrombin (Thrombin precursor for clotting)
- [ ] E) Hemoglobin (Intra-erythrocytic oxygen transport)

> **✅ Answers:** A) Serum Albumin (Osmotic pressure maintenance), B) Gamma Globulins (Humoral antibody defense), C) Fibrinogen (Blood clotting cascade), D) Prothrombin (Thrombin precursor for clotting)
> **Explanation:** Plasma proteins include Albumin, Globulin, Fibrinogen, and Prothrombin. Hemoglobin is inside RBCs.

### PA_T3_MSQ_10: In Topic 3, select all types of Dense Connective Tissue: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT (Tendons)
- [ ] B) Dense Irregular White Collagenous CT (Dermis of skin)
- [ ] C) Yellow Elastic CT (Artery walls & Ligaments)
- [ ] D) Loose Areolar CT
- [ ] E) Adipose CT

> **✅ Answers:** A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT (Tendons), B) Dense Irregular White Collagenous CT (Dermis of skin), C) Yellow Elastic CT (Artery walls & Ligaments)
> **Explanation:** Dense CT categories: Dense Regular, Dense Irregular, and Elastic CT. Areolar and Adipose are Loose CT.
